# Vamos Tennis Newsletter

Conversational alternative to the Streamlit prototype (`app.py`) in this repo. A
courses CSV is optional (covers promo-only newsletters too). The newsletter HTML is
**not** generated by a script — write and edit it directly as plain markup, following
the reference below. That's what makes this conversational: revise by editing text,
no rebuild step. Don't edit the root-level app files as part of this skill.

Two scripts in `scripts/`:
- `parse_courses.py` (+ `csv_processor.py`) — CSV → display-ready JSON (formatted
  times/dates, spots flags). Use its output directly; don't hand-parse the CSV or
  hand-format dates/times yourself.
- `send_to_kit.py` — the only network step. Reads `kit_api_key` from
  `.streamlit/secrets.toml` and POSTs the final payload to Kit.

## Flow

1. **CSV (optional)**: if Juvern has one, give them the download link (6-week window
   from today — see snippet below), get the local path, run
   `python3 scripts/parse_courses.py <path>` → `{"adults": [...], "juniors": [...]}`.
2. **Events/promotions**: title, description, URL, optional *hosted* image URL
   (email can't embed local files). No cap on how many.
3. **Content order**: propose adults → juniors → events, let Juvern reorder.
4. **Draft blurbs** yourself in chat (no LLM call) — see copy rules below. Show each
   for approval before moving on.
5. **Write the newsletter HTML** per the reference below. Show it to Juvern (or save
   to a file) — plain markup, so edits are just text edits, by either of you.
6. **Draft subject / preview text / summary** in chat — see copy rules below. Add the
   summary as the newsletter's first block.
7. **Confirm before sending**: show the full `{subject, content, preview_text}`
   payload and get an explicit yes — this creates a real Kit broadcast (draft state,
   but still real). Never run step 8 without it.
8. **Send**: `echo '<payload json>' | python3 scripts/send_to_kit.py`. Report the
   result. Remind Juvern to import the latest ClubSpark contact list into Kit before
   sending from Kit's dashboard.

CSV download link snippet (6 weeks from today):
```bash
python3 -c "
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
today = datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
end = (datetime.now() + timedelta(weeks=6)).strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
print(f'https://clubspark.lta.org.uk/VamosTennis/Admin/Coaching/CoachingReports/Coaching_Courses?startdateforfiltering={today}&enddateforfiltering={end}&category=&status=Upcoming&leadcoachforfiltering=&venue=')
"
```

## Copy rules

- **Adult level description**: <100 chars, encouraging, explains what the level's
  for, no emoji. Juniors use fixed colour-tier text (below) — no blurb needed.
- **Event description**: ≤3 sentences, warm not salesy, limited emoji. Only mention
  date/time/venue if Juvern explicitly gave them — never invent one.
- **Subject line**: <60 chars, one emoji max at the start, exclamation marks only if
  genuinely warranted, specific to the actual content.
- **Preview text**: <150 chars, no emoji, no exclamation marks, conversational.
- **Summary** (intro, 1-2 sentences): name the specific things on offer, name any
  event, one emoji fine but not at the start, no exclamation marks.
- Real dates/venues only, everywhere — never invented.

## HTML reference

Worked example (summary + event + adults + juniors, showing every construct):

```html
<div style="width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start;">
<div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; text-align: left; padding: 0 20px;">

<div style="margin: 40px 0;">
  <p>{summary — first block, only if drafted}</p>
</div>

<div style="margin: 40px 0;">
<h2>{event title}</h2>
<img src="{image}" alt="{event title}" style="width: 100%; max-width: 600px; margin: 10px auto; display: block;" />
<p>{event blurb}</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">
    <a href="{event url}" class="cta-button">Book Your Spot</a>
</p>
</div>

<h2>Adult Courses</h2>
<h3>Beginner</h3>
<p>{Beginner blurb}</p>
<ul>
<li>{day} {time} @ {venue} — {duration} starting {start_date}{flag}</li>
</ul>
        <p style="text-align: center;">
            <a href="https://clubspark.lta.org.uk/VamosTennis/Coaching/Adult?skill-level%5B%5D=1&date-range[]=%22{earliest_iso for Beginner}%22" class="cta-button">Book Beginner</a>
        </p>
<!-- repeat <h3>/<p>/<ul>/button for each level present, in order: Improver(id 8), Intermediate(id 2), Advanced(id 4) -->

<h2>Term Time Junior Courses</h2>
<h3>🔵 Blue (4–6)</h3>
<p>New to tennis.</p>
<ul>
<li>{day} {time} @ {venue} — {duration} starting {start_date}{flag}</li>
</ul>
<!-- repeat <h3>/<p>/<ul> for each colour present, in order: Red, Orange, Green — text below, no per-colour button -->
        <p style="text-align: center;">
            <a href="https://clubspark.lta.org.uk/VamosTennis/Coaching/Junior" class="cta-button">Book Junior Courses</a>
        </p>

</div>
</div>
```

Notes:
- Omit the event `<img>` if no image; omit its button `<p>` if no URL.
- Skip any adult level / junior colour with zero courses (and skip skill level
  `"Unknown"`).
- `{flag}`: `" <strong>(Limited spots!)</strong>"` if `spots_flag == "limited"`,
  `" <strong>(Full!)</strong>"` if `"full"`, else nothing.
- Adult booking URL's `{earliest_iso}` = minimum `start_date_iso` among that level's
  courses (from `parse_courses.py`).
- Junior block gets **one** booking button total, after all colour groups — not one
  per colour.

Junior colour text (fixed — don't invent your own):

| Colour | Heading | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Blue | 🔵 Blue (4–6) | New to tennis. |
| Red | 🔴 Red (6–8) | Rallying, volleying, serving. |
| Orange | 🟠 Orange (8–11) | Hitting from mid-court and learning tactics. Great for beginners and improvers. |
| Green | 🟢 Green (11–14) | Playing on full-size courts with standard balls. All levels welcome, with drills matched to ability. |
